messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; one of the busiest airports on the West Coast. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the oldest major hubs; key connecting point for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Largest airport in Texas; major hub for American Airlines. |
| Denver International Airport | Denver, CO | DEN | Largest airport in the Rocky Mountain region; hub for United and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport | New York City, NY | JFK | Major hub for international flights; primary gateway for many airlines. |
| San Francisco International Airport | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Key hub for transpacific flights; major focus city for United Airlines. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing hub for Delta. |
| Miami International Airport | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for international flights to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport | Phoenix, AZ | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; high volume of domestic traffic. |
| Orlando International Airport | Orlando, FL | ORL | Major hub for leisure travel; significant seasonal traffic. |
| Newark Liberty International Airport | Newark, NJ | EWR | Major hub for United Airlines; important for Northeast Corridor traffic. |
| Charlotte Douglas International Airport | Charlotte, NC | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; growing international traffic. |
| Washington Dulles International Airport | Washington, D.C. | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; key for government and diplomatic travel. |

These airports serve as major hubs for both domestic and international flights, handling millions of passengers each year and providing extensive connectivity across the globe.
